Europe's oldest universities date back almost a thousand years, with Bologna traditionally founded in 1088, followed by Oxford (c. 1096), Paris (c. 1150) and Cambridge (1209). Founding dates are traditional or approximate, but the order is widely agreed. Which historic institution do you think has shaped modern education the most?
